test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the number of accident happened in a city during the year 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3597b47964964c3b325282f6b94f9da563ef044b8d82496bfcdc8b1771091a5.png] 

B = difference in accidents of two wheelers and buses. B is what percent of total number of accidents?
solution:
**Calculation:**

B = difference in accidents of two-wheelers and buses

B = 330 - 180 = 150

Total number of accidents:

220 + 180 + 200 + 330 + 70 = 1000

According to the question:

150/1000 × 100 = 15%

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
